verdict.rationale: Terminal emulators can collect user data or ship AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has nothing on WezTerm's data handling, telemetry, or any policy or control on using user data for AI training. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
